purpose: Reconcile existing14Etests,12Jprototype subjects,20Kfunctional states and13Jtraveler steps to current configuration. Preserves exact predecessor records. No new test result or authorized test method.
gate_reference_meaning: Related open closure subjects, not a demand to close every train-wide gate before scoped component qualification. Each isolated fixture/coupon/component test requires its own accepted scope, protocol, limits, safe setup and responsible release; it cannot release the whole train.

predecessor_record.title: Incoming configuration and wheel-load baseline
predecessor_record.purpose: Verify serial/revision, measured masses, all wheel reactions, as-built geometry and support condition using calibrated weighing equipment; retain every wheel reading and uncertainty.

records.current_requirement: Current custom wheelsets/trucks, separately configured accessible car and locomotive; record actual as-built mass/CG and EACH wheel reaction across accepted empty/loaded/twist states. Nominal upper mass or equal division is not a baseline measurement.

predecessor_record.title: Floor bay, seam and hard-point qualification
predecessor_record.purpose: Qualify real panel/closure/support assembly and concentrated/rolling/anchor behavior; characterize stiffness and damage, separating panel-relative deflection from simultaneous support movement and reporting total floor movement.

records.current_requirement: O1 identified zero vertical isolation at I-SH1. Revise and release exact production seat/sole/spacer/panel/insert/seal stack before qualification. Measure frame and floor motions separately; regular64feet do not define accessible supports.

predecessor_record.title: Brake actuator and hydraulic response maps
predecessor_record.purpose: Measure force/travel/pressure over approved wear/temperature points; blocked drain and auxiliary-release failure paths under controlled fixture protocol.

records.current_requirement: DO NOT execute hydraulic actuator/blocked-drain/auxiliary-release test as D1. Replace its current-use scope with exact D1 service pressure/stroke/output-torque and spring parking maps, both rotation directions, low-torque modulation, wear/temperature and release/drag. Include selected cam/slack/chamber geometry and maximum service/spring/fault force; anti-compounding/transfer requires its own accepted protocol. No pressure, cage or fixture instruction is supplied here.

predecessor_record.title: Secured coach service/emergency and reset
predecessor_record.purpose: Prove local application, traction inhibit, deliberate reset and no unintended release after power restoration or controller reboot.

records.current_requirement: Use exact current distributor/relay/spring anti-compounding arrangement and local actual D1 response. Demonstrate traction inhibit, deliberate reset and no uncommanded release.3K is a proposed state requirement, not tested controller code.

predecessor_record.title: Secured separation and communication faults
predecessor_record.purpose: Simulate coupler separation while jumpers remain connected; open/short/stale commands and controlled jumper sequence without moving separation.

records.current_requirement: Every actual coupling position and both separated portions;32coach chambers PLUS unresolved locomotive package. Retain independent physical brake command on both portions even with electrical jumpers attached; characterize BP-only/MR-only failures and trapped/self-sealed/closed-cock states. No live separation or hose cutting is authorized.

predecessor_record.title: Parking, recovery and restoration
predecessor_record.purpose: Prove engineer-defined disturbance/hold duration and recovery restraint; record auxiliary release and restored normal status.

records.current_requirement: Parking is spring-applied/air-released, not hydraulic auxiliary release. Prove accepted service-to-spring handover without overforce/rollaway; exact OEM mechanical release/caging and independent restraint belong in a separately authorized rescue procedure. Tag and restore every disabled brake; no passenger use in unaccepted degraded mode.

predecessor_record.title: Tare and ballasted single-coach braking
predecessor_record.purpose: Measure approved increasing-speed service/emergency runs, equal/unequal loading and permitted degraded cases with restraint/containment defined.

records.current_requirement: Actual completed single coach, masses, wheel/rail profiles, new/worn braking geometry and load control. Engineer sets guarded increasing-energy method, limits/abort criteria and track containment; this crosswalk authorizes no run speed, ballast load or disabled-brake case.

predecessor_record.title: Full-consist response and brake balance
predecessor_record.purpose: Measure each vehicle response, joint load, stop distance, jerk and wheel/ground discrepancy in both travel directions; actual full configuration recorded.

records.current_requirement: Instrument actual loco+3regular+1accessible consist. Record each vehicle/critical branch pressure and mechanical brake response, wheel speed/slide, synchronized command/timing, drawbar force, deceleration/jerk, stop distance and temperatures in accepted directions/load/fault cases. Account for full32coach chamber volume plus locomotive/lines/valves.

predecessor_record.title: Adhesion and environmental robustness
predecessor_record.purpose: Verify approved rail conditions, hot/cold starts and repeated-stop duty; wheel-slide behavior and stopping reserve. No casual rail contamination or live hose cutting.

records.current_requirement: D1 forward/reverse low-friction modulation, spring emergency overlap, empty/loaded wheel-slide behavior and hot repeated duty with actual rail condition. Engineer accepts safe environmental simulation and containment; no casual rail contamination or uncontrolled spring application.

predecessor_record.title: Source transfer and electrical protection
predecessor_record.purpose: Prove shore movement inhibit, source isolation, phase/fault protection, bonding and restart/load shedding under approved methods.

records.current_requirement: Actual hotel source/DC supply, neutral/bond/protection and compressor assignment. Obsolete hydraulic DC-B07 must not appear as current load or battery sizing. Verify source isolation, moving shore inhibit and restart/load shedding using actual supply fault study.

predecessor_record.title: HVAC installed duty and starting
predecessor_record.purpose: Measure delivered cooling/heating/ventilation, starting dips, restart staging, condensate, intake/exhaust and noise/vibration.

records.current_requirement: P1 heat-placement reconciliation and P2 exact HVAC/ADB/manual variant apply. Verify real outside-air path, dirty-filter/static duty, actual unit starting and generator recovery, roof clamp/support, condensate and locomotive exhaust separation. Recirculation fan flow is not ventilation.

predecessor_record.title: Blackout, E-stop and emergency lighting
predecessor_record.stage: Secured unoccupied train and later approved site exercise
predecessor_record.purpose: Record combined hotel loss/brake DC loss scenarios separately; E-stop application and lighting reserve for approved evacuation duration.

records.current_requirement: Separate hotel loss, brake-control DC loss, compressor loss and combined failures under accepted safe fixtures. Record air reserve, actual service/spring transient, propulsion removal and independent emergency lighting/communications. Generic battery6A allocation is not a verified reserve.

predecessor_record.title: Installed normal boarding and evacuation equipment
predecessor_record.stage: Secured installed equipment before participant exercises
predecessor_record.purpose: Qualify exact station/coach bridge or lift interface at both stations using OEM/engineer-defined loads, conditions and methods. Verify normal deployment, retention, stowage, inhibits, power-loss recovery and accepted alternate/wayside equipment. No floor mockup substitutes for installed evidence.

records.current_requirement: Actual installed origin andNorthPole interfaces at accepted empty/loaded/roll floor states, not nominal28/32in datum. Exact bridge/lift/ramp/stair mechanism, stow/locks/interlocks, power-loss recovery and structure need engineer/OEM limits and qualification before people are used.

predecessor_record.title: Operational handover and evacuation exercise
predecessor_record.purpose: Only after accepted E14 equipment records and an approved evacuation protocol, perform supervised normal boarding at both stations and appropriate participant exercises for power loss, blocked exits and wayside recovery. Verify staffing, communications, inspection and restoration; do not expose participants to unqualified equipment or inject unsafe faults.

records.current_requirement: Keep E14 qualification and approved accessible emergency protocol as prerequisites. Existing3E full-size floor mockup is a separate earlier activity, not installed acceptance. Supervised participant exercises only after equipment/route qualification; no injected unsafe fault around participants.

predecessor_record.load_description: No external load; nonstructural geometry sample
predecessor_record.measure: Tools, sight lines, rail-end bead reservation, underside access and removable panel paths
predecessor_record.acceptance_basis_needed: Access interference is a redesign finding; engineer approves required clearances before release

records.current_requirement: Retain actual tools/access checks; include D1 hub/drum removal together with bearing/wheel retained, but only after controlled brake geometry. No outboard removal path is proved yet.

predecessor_record.measure: Zero-load coordinates, four-foot plane, twist, fixture compliance, instrument zero
predecessor_record.acceptance_basis_needed: Acceptance tolerances assigned on released specimen drawing

records.current_requirement: Relate fixture datums to current body/frame and load states; do not use inherited32in as an accepted loaded floor. Retain instrument-zero and fixture compliance evidence.

predecessor_record.specimen_fixture: Actual four-foot seat, sole connections, rails and panel bypass
predecessor_record.measure: Foot reaction sharing, rail/receiver strain, cap/sole deflection, local wall dents, residual set
predecessor_record.acceptance_basis_needed: Not defined by the 305 kg study allowance; accepted seat load standard and test factor required

records.current_requirement: Resolve O1 seat/floor bypass first; exact cap/sole/spacer/seat/panel build and all force paths required.

predecessor_record.load_description: Engineer-defined signed force at accepted CG with gravity combination
predecessor_record.specimen_fixture: Test seat/substitute stiffness and actual sole joints
predecessor_record.measure: Both ±x; foot uplift/compression, bolt slip/prying, local wall motion, fixture rotation
predecessor_record.acceptance_basis_needed: Study reference: 305 kg and1g at24in CG; not a proof test target

records.current_requirement: Actual selected seat bolts/grip/locking and local member stiffness; no trial hole/bolt/weld can be promoted to accepted hardware by testing an unapproved specimen.

predecessor_record.load_description: Engineer-defined ±y and any required concurrent load combinations
predecessor_record.measure: Lateral transfer, torsion, cap/cheek strain, seat back and leg response
predecessor_record.acceptance_basis_needed: Separate ±0.5g study does not establish required concurrent multi-axis test

records.current_requirement: Retain combined-axis subject; actual restraint/seat geometry and accessible support schedules differ, so coupon result cannot silently cover both coaches.

predecessor_record.load_description: Engineer-defined V/M/N/T with compatible end stiffness
predecessor_record.specimen_fixture: Separate coupon including real corners and main-face/diaphragm design
predecessor_record.measure: Relative rotation, receiver-face deformation, weld toe/root response, effective transfer length
predecessor_record.acceptance_basis_needed: Reference V5.971 kN and M1.618 kNm only for original2× floor sensitivity; not auto test acceptance

records.current_requirement: CM6 is a trial member/local joint. Actual receiving HSS wall, effective weld length, process and distortion/inspection must be accepted; J1a mesh does not contain its weld/detail assembly.

predecessor_record.load_description: Engineer-defined signed horizontal/vertical and moment combination
predecessor_record.specimen_fixture: Worst-family thin outer receiver, not stronger central receiver surrogate
predecessor_record.measure: Receiver wall and endpoint stiffness; reversible sign response
predecessor_record.acceptance_basis_needed: Reference worst recorded endpoint V2.809 kN,N1.496 kN,M0.258 kNm; simultaneous true load path must be rederived

records.current_requirement: Retain thin receiving-wall/end stiffness and reversible force direction; do not infer acceptance from a nominal shell contact.

predecessor_record.specimen_fixture: Actual OEM panel, closeouts/inserts, seals and clips
predecessor_record.measure: Bearing contact, core/skin/insert damage, slip, wet leakage and removal/reinstall
predecessor_record.acceptance_basis_needed: Prior0.371612 kN clip force is1kPa×24×24in sensitivity, not panel/insert rating

records.current_requirement: Pursue actual panel/insert/closeout/retention and thermal/wet evidence after O1 stack revision. Thermal sensitivity is not a qualified seam.

predecessor_record.load_description: Engineer-defined centre-bearing and side-bearer reactions including contact/gap states
predecessor_record.specimen_fixture: Actual OEM mount, local reinforcement and representative frame stiffness
predecessor_record.measure: Bearing pressure, local bottom/sidewall strains, roll couple, retention and residual set
predecessor_record.acceptance_basis_needed: No test around rejected I-BA root without redesign; actual OEM boundary conditions required

records.current_requirement: Requires completed custom body bearing/pivot/sidebearer/retention and truck support law, not G1 display hardware or a generic bought bogie.

predecessor_record.load_description: Accepted cycle spectrum and load ranges; no invented cycle count
predecessor_record.specimen_fixture: Representative accepted detail, material, weld and corrosion state
predecessor_record.measure: Crack monitoring, stiffness change and inspection interval evidence
predecessor_record.acceptance_basis_needed: Static success is not a fatigue-life demonstration; spectrum/category/cycles must be engineer-approved

records.current_requirement: Engineer-set fatigue spectrum, specimen geometry, defect/inspection/abort criteria and correlation; static margin or one proof test cannot establish fatigue life.

predecessor_record.specimen_fixture: Complete accepted frame and actual or justified test support stiffness
predecessor_record.measure: Support reactions, deflection/twist, local hotspots, mass/CG and residual set
predecessor_record.acceptance_basis_needed: Coupon results cannot establish full-frame load path or a coach mass rating

records.current_requirement: J1a110members is only a member subtotal: accepted actual joints, supports, accessible-specific structure and full mass/CG/floor motion must be included in the released test configuration.

predecessor_record.load_description: Approved empty then ballasted vehicle cases
predecessor_record.specimen_fixture: Complete bogies, air brakes, couplings and qualified test track
predecessor_record.measure: Articulation/clearance, stopping/parking/failure response, wheel loads and temperatures
predecessor_record.acceptance_basis_needed: Separate commissioning test plan; no occupied trials during development

records.current_requirement: Current custom truck, D1 air/spring brake, complete coupling, drive and actual track must replace earlier proxy interfaces; match E07/E08/E09/E14 and all20Kstates before vehicle-level release.

predecessor_record.event: Charged, authorized run
predecessor_record.BP: Charged at accepted release level
predecessor_record.service: Released; each car reservoir proven ready
predecessor_record.spring_parking: Air released only after service reserve, continuity and brake-state checks pass
predecessor_record.evidence_or_hold: Pressure values, ready thresholds and physical brake-release proof held
predecessor_record.architecture_B_difference: Positive-pressure service line is low/exhausted in release; supply charged.
predecessor_record.classification: proposed behavior / required proof; not tested

records.current_requirement: Actual D1 release and local reserve readiness on every vehicle, not head/tail pressure alone.32coach chambers plus actual locomotive branch count; prove mechanical release before propulsion permission. Actual settings, accepted limits and implementation remain unresolved.

predecessor_record.event: Normal graduated service
predecessor_record.BP: Controlled reduction
predecessor_record.service: Local reservoir powers a metered application, load limited
predecessor_record.spring_parking: Normally remains air released
predecessor_record.evidence_or_hold: Actual distributor-to-semi-chamber relay and load schedule require OEM integration
predecessor_record.architecture_B_difference: Positive pressure rises in service line to command the local relay.
predecessor_record.classification: proposed behavior / required proof; not tested

records.current_requirement: Accept pressure-to-service-stroke-to-wheel-torque/load schedule with Type20service section and actual S-cam/slack geometry. Low-force modulation must suit empty/loaded rail adhesion in both directions; nominal diaphragm area is not brake torque. Actual settings, accepted limits and implementation remain unresolved.

predecessor_record.event: Driver emergency, MR intact
predecessor_record.BP: Rapid vent / emergency reduction
predecessor_record.service: Local reserve emergency application on every vehicle
predecessor_record.spring_parking: Remains released during pneumatic emergency unless separate park/fallback command acts; parking applied after stop
predecessor_record.evidence_or_hold: Emergency rate, force and timing held; do not assume BP loss itself exhausts spring chambers
predecessor_record.architecture_B_difference: Separate emergency function must be demonstrated; positive-service pipe alone is insufficient.
predecessor_record.classification: proposed behavior / required proof; not tested

records.current_requirement: With MR intact, BP emergency does not inherently vent spring-release chambers. Demonstrate every local service application, actual timing and stopped parking transfer without assuming spring application from BP loss. Actual settings, accepted limits and implementation remain unresolved.

predecessor_record.event: Parking at standstill
predecessor_record.BP: Service hold available during transition
predecessor_record.MR: May remain charged or subsequently isolated
predecessor_record.service: Transfer load without unaccepted force addition or a roll-away gap
predecessor_record.spring_parking: Command release chamber vent; spring holding independently demonstrated
predecessor_record.evidence_or_hold: Anti-compounding and force handover must work with selected foundation brake
predecessor_record.architecture_B_difference: Equivalent holding objective; exact road valve arrangement not inherited.
predecessor_record.classification: proposed behavior / required proof; not tested

records.current_requirement: Use D1 actual service and spring curves to prove holding transfer without excessive summed force or a restraint gap. Anti-compounding valve/control behavior must be accepted with the complete foundation brake. Actual settings, accepted limits and implementation remain unresolved.

predecessor_record.event: BP-only rupture, MR and electrical permit intact
predecessor_record.BP: Falls on all portions exposed to rupture; no automatic self-seal permitted to mask this
predecessor_record.service: Automatic service/emergency application from each healthy local reserve; classify actual response by rupture rate
predecessor_record.spring_parking: Does NOT inherently apply: spring release may remain pressurized
predecessor_record.evidence_or_hold: Tiny leak masked by charging can delay response; leakage, feed cut-off and abnormal pressure monitoring require tests
predecessor_record.architecture_B_difference: A positive-pressure service-only rupture can cause failed/released service while supply keeps springs released. Independent emergency detection required.
predecessor_record.classification: proposed behavior / required proof; not tested

records.current_requirement: BP-only leak/rupture with MR still charged can leave springs air-released. Prove leak/feed/vent discrimination and actual local service response, not just a full-separation demonstration. Actual settings, accepted limits and implementation remain unresolved.

predecessor_record.event: MR-only rupture, BP initially intact
predecessor_record.BP: Can remain charged; low-supply/reserve supervision must request BP emergency
predecessor_record.service: Local reserves isolated against back-drain; command controlled emergency before depletion
predecessor_record.spring_parking: Local parking supply behavior must be documented; eventual loss of release air applies springs, but timing is not automatic evidence
predecessor_record.evidence_or_hold: A check valve preserves air but does not issue a brake command. Low-supply trip and spring handover require independent proof
predecessor_record.architecture_B_difference: Supply loss may operate selected road spring valve; application timing and both-side behavior remain circuit-specific.
predecessor_record.classification: proposed behavior / required proof; not tested

records.current_requirement: MR-only loss requires local-reserve isolation and a proved command before usable reserve is lost. A check valve alone does not command braking; document subsequent spring-release depletion and actual force transition. Actual settings, accepted limits and implementation remain unresolved.

predecessor_record.event: Full separation between any two vehicles
predecessor_record.BP: Both severed BP ends must vent their connected portions
predecessor_record.MR: Both severed MR ends vent; local reserves retained
predecessor_record.service: All vehicles on BOTH portions apply from their own usable reserves
predecessor_record.spring_parking: Safety-permit separation also requests parking fallback; combined-force sequencing must not overbrake
predecessor_record.evidence_or_hold: Test every coupling. Self-sealing BP connectors, closed cocks or rear-loss isolation can defeat this objective
predecessor_record.architecture_B_difference: Do not copy road synchronizing protection that deliberately prevents forward-portion emergency on rear loss.
predecessor_record.classification: proposed behavior / required proof; not tested

records.current_requirement: For each of4actual intervehicle joints, both portions need usable local braking and appropriate propulsion removal. Reconcile32coach chambers plus locomotive, cock/connector/isolation behavior and electrical-jumper persistence. No moving separation test authorized. Actual settings, accepted limits and implementation remain unresolved.

predecessor_record.event: Safety/control power loss
predecessor_record.BP: Loss of energized-to-run permit must cause local mechanically defaulting BP vent
predecessor_record.service: Base distributor/relay emergency must not depend on computer or data network
predecessor_record.spring_parking: Proposed local default is spring application, with pneumatic anti-compounding; actual transient is HELD until validated
predecessor_record.evidence_or_hold: No software-only stop or electrically timed delay credited; spring/service overlap and wheel slide need proof
predecessor_record.architecture_B_difference: Road-style candidate also needs independent power-loss emergency architecture.
predecessor_record.classification: proposed behavior / required proof; not tested

records.current_requirement: Record current brake DC versus hotel loss separately. Base pneumatic emergency cannot rely on software; actual spring default and service/spring overlap require measured torque/timing/slide evidence with accepted safe fixtures. Actual settings, accepted limits and implementation remain unresolved.

predecessor_record.event: Compressor stops
predecessor_record.BP: Initially unchanged; low-ready condition must initiate stop
predecessor_record.service: Finite local reserve supports defined stop, not indefinite repeated cycles
predecessor_record.spring_parking: Maintain/release only while accepted reserve available; park after stop
predecessor_record.traction: Inhibited before loss of required reserve
predecessor_record.evidence_or_hold: Compute leakage, repeated applications, cold operation and reserve depletion; acceptance pressure/time held
predecessor_record.architecture_B_difference: Same finite-air issue; tank present does not prove reserve capacity.
predecessor_record.classification: proposed behavior / required proof; not tested

records.current_requirement: Use complete actual chambers/lines/reservoirs/valves and leakage/repeated-stop duty to establish usable reserve and compressor-loss response. Current compressor supply assignment and locomotive package remain unresolved. Actual settings, accepted limits and implementation remain unresolved.

predecessor_record.event: Closed BP end cock or distributor isolation
predecessor_record.BP: Rear may stay falsely charged or be disconnected from command
predecessor_record.service: Rear command may be absent; local isolated car can have no service brake
predecessor_record.spring_parking: May remain released
predecessor_record.traction: Dispatch inhibited; if found in motion stop using verified brakes
predecessor_record.evidence_or_hold: Static head/tail pressure alone cannot prove continuity; commanded application and release at every car required
predecessor_record.architecture_B_difference: Same false-ready hazard; adding electrical continuity alone does not prove pneumatic brake operation.
predecessor_record.classification: proposed behavior / required proof; not tested

records.current_requirement: Closed-cock/isolated-car faults can retain static pressure while losing command. Accepted continuity proof must observe commanded application AND release at every actual vehicle; no dispatch on pressure-only indication. Actual settings, accepted limits and implementation remain unresolved.

predecessor_record.event: Service relay stuck exhausted / no application
predecessor_record.BP: Valid brake demand may exist
predecessor_record.service: Affected branch fails to apply despite valid pilot
predecessor_record.spring_parking: Independent spring may help only if its own path and foundation remain healthy
predecessor_record.evidence_or_hold: Monitor delivered cylinder pressure plus actual actuator/brake response. Common linkage failure defeats both sections
predecessor_record.architecture_B_difference: Same branch failure; relay redundancy/fault tolerance remains engineering decision.
predecessor_record.classification: proposed behavior / required proof; not tested

records.current_requirement: Prove detection of valid pilot but absent service pressure/mechanical torque in one D1 branch. Spring backup is not independent if the common cam/linkage/friction assembly is failed. Actual settings, accepted limits and implementation remain unresolved.

predecessor_record.service: Brake remains applied; heat and wheel slide possible
predecessor_record.spring_parking: Do not add spring force blindly
predecessor_record.evidence_or_hold: Pressure indication does not establish pad release; no passenger movement with isolated brake unless accepted degraded-mode plan
predecessor_record.architecture_B_difference: Same trapped-pressure hazard.
predecessor_record.classification: proposed behavior / required proof; not tested

Actual settings, accepted limits and implementation remain unresolved.

predecessor_record.BP: May be normal

predecessor_record.service: Affected branch loses useful brake; healthy reserves remain if isolation works

predecessor_record.MR: Not evidence of an operable brake
